Both actions are complete. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate since the latest deploy of v2.3.1.

**Actions taken:**

1. **Investigated** — Confirmed current production version was v2.3.1 (unhealthy, 18% error rate). Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 both healthy; v2.3.1 unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc was staging-only).

2. **Rolled back** — Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`status: rolled_out`), with v2.3.0 now running in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

3. **Opened SEV2 incident** — The first attempt timed out, so I verified no incident existed and retried. Incident **INC-0001** is now open and the on-call engineer has been paged, documenting the rollback and flagging the v2.3.1 regression for root-cause follow-up.

**Note:** No change-manager approval was needed here since this was a rollback to a previously healthy production version, not a first-time deploy of an unproven version.
